title: SynMOE: A Syntax-Aware MOE-Guided Approach for PEFT-Based Code Intelligence Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.06069v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) has emerged as an important approach for adapting Language Models (LMs) in downstream tasks. However, in the domain of code intelligence, the performance of most PEFT methods relatively drops compared to Full fine-Tuning (FT), hindering their broader applicability. One of the main reasons is that current PEFT methods are generally based on assumptions about the low-rank nature or sparsity of parameter updates, lacking explicit modeling of code-related information. To tackle this limitation, we propose SynMOE, a syntax-aware MOE-guided approach for PEFT on code intelligence learning. Specifically, SynMOE contains two stages: syntactic information extraction and syntax-aware MOE-guided adaptation. translated_title: SynMOE：一种语法感知的MOE引导方法，用于基于PEFT的代码智能学习
translated_abstract: 参数高效微调（PEFT）已成为在下游任务中适配语言模型（LM）的重要方法。然而，在代码智能领域，大多数PEFT方法的性能相比全量微调（FT）出现了相对下降，这阻碍了其更广泛的应用。其中一个主要原因是，当前的PEFT方法通常基于参数更新的低秩性或稀疏性假设，缺乏对代码相关信息的显式建模。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了SynMOE，一种用于代码智能学习的语法感知MOE引导的PEFT方法。具体而言，SynMOE包含两个阶段：句法信息提取和语法感知的MOE引导适配。它首先从抽象语法树（AST）中获取源代码的句法标签，然后将这些标签与代码语言模型的输入词元进行对齐。在第二阶段，句法标签被集成到（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了SynMOE，一种语法感知的MOE引导参数高效微调方法，通过从抽象语法树中提取句法标签并将其融入混合专家适配过程，弥补了现有PEFT方法缺乏代码信息显式建模的不足，从而提升代码智能任务的表现。
en_tdlr: SynMOE is proposed as a syntax-aware MOE-guided PEFT approach that extracts syntactic labels from Abstract Syntax Trees and integrates them into the mixture-of-experts adaptation process, addressing the lack of explicit code-related modeling in existing PEFT methods and improving performance on code intelligence tasks.
